'''2023 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP, October–November 2023. [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Timo Dusel]] in the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-10-2023-online-championship-series-playoffs/. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022033718/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2023-10-2023-online-championship-series-playoffs.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-ocs-wrap-desai-wins-incredible-fourth-title/ 2023 OCS Wrap - Desai Wins Incredible Fourth Title], starwarsccg.org (6 December 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022203015/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2023-ocs-wrap-desai-wins-incredible-fourth-title.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Schedule and highlights ==
* '''Round of 16:''' streamed matches from 20–23 October 2023 included [[Sam Tashima]] (<code>Yoshi</code>) vs. “stimpy” (20 October), [[Justin Branch]] (<code>Silverglen</code>) vs. [[Jeff Lavigne]] (<code>Treadwell</code>) (22 October), [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (<code>MatthewHT</code>) vs. [[Justin Desai]] (<code>allstarz97</code>) (22–23 October), and [[Mike Kessling]] vs. [[Jared Napolitano]] (23 October).<ref name="slack-ocs23-r16">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, James Martin (solidsnck), 20 and 23 October 2023: Round of 16 playoff stream schedule.</ref>
* '''Quarterfinals:''' on 7 November 2023, [[Jeff Lavigne]] defeated [[Sam Tashima]] in Game 1 (+15; 24 life force to 43), and [[Drew Lichtenstein]] (<code>CoffeePass</code>) faced [[Mike Kessling]].<ref name="slack-ocs23-qf">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, James Martin (solidsnck), 7 November 2023: “Yoshi vs treadwell: Game 1 treadwell +15 (24 LP, Yoshi 43). Game 2: Tue. 11/7 7:00 PM Eastern. / CoffeePass vs Kessling: Game 1 Tues. 11/7, 8:30 PM Eastern.”</ref>
* '''Semifinals:''' [[Sam Tashima]] vs. [[Timo Dusel]] (<code>dillen</code>) concluded on 16 November 2023.<ref name="slack-ocs23-sf">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, James Martin (solidsnck), 16 November 2023: “Reminder that your OCS Finalists will be set today: Yoshi vs dillen: Game 2 Thu 11/16 4 PM ET”.</ref>
* '''Finals:''' [[Justin Desai]] vs. [[Timo Dusel]] was streamed on Friday, 24 November 2023 at 10 AM EST.<ref name="slack-ocs23-fin">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, James Martin (solidsnck), 21 November 2023: “Garrett and Dan will stream the OCS Finals this Friday at 10am Eastern”.</ref>

== Prediction contest ==

A Top 16 prediction contest took entries from 13 October 2023 until 16 October 2023. The winner's prize was a Death Star II playmat. Second place was a gold Players Committee booster pack. Third place was a green one.<ref name="ocs-predict">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83698 2023 OCS Top 16 Prediction Contest], forum.starwarsccg.org (11 October – 24 November 2023).</ref>
